activity_summary: At the morning rehearsal you ran Gaunt as the book is played. He dies in the second act. Nothing was put back into the play. You did not call the afternoon the sixth time before it had happened. Burbage takes the rest of the king from the tiring-house door.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept to Gaunt, and refused an early count.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Set the second act as the end of the part, and closed the rehearsal.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Confirmed the join, and kept the rest of the king from the door.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in The jaw, and nothing restored

facets.activity: Rehearsed Gaunt as the book is played

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: The book as we play it. Nothing put back.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not call it the sixth until it has been the sixth.
